messages:
jen_support: FYI customer ticket #C-1829. They started seeing intermittent 502s from hosted inference in eu-west1 ~03:40 UTC. Their logs show TLS handshake timeouts and long DNS lookup times.

maria_runtime: Do we have any recent cert rotations around that time for eu-west1?

tom_sre: No scheduled cert rollouts in that window. I see a brief spike in resolver latency from our edge logs for eu-west1 at 03:39-03:46. Query latencies up to 1.8s for some A and SRV lookups.

jen_support: Customer reports error pattern like: "upstream TLS handshake timeout" and occasional "dial tcp: i/o timeout". They hit our hosted API endpoint: api.eu-west1.redwoodapi.com.

alex_eng: Can you paste a raw sample from the customer (curl -v) if they have it?

jen_support: Customer provided this snippet: ```
$ curl -v https://api.eu-west1.redwoodapi.com/v1/generate 
> ... 
* Connected to api.eu-west1.redwoodapi.com (52.35.12.7) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake timeout
* Closing connection 0
* Failed to connect to api.eu-west1.redwoodapi.com port 443: Timeout
```

maria_runtime: That looks resolver-ish or network path. Any client-side proxies? They said no. I also see an elevated SERVFAIL rate from one of our public resolvers around the same time.

tom_sre: I pulled edge trace for a sample 502: 
```
edge node: eu-west1-gw-12
upstream: backend-pool-3
error: tls handshake timeout during dial to 10.0.45.9:443
resolver: 198.51.100.53 latency 1.73s status SERVFAIL
```

oncall-bot: Pager sent to @oncall-sre at 03:41:12 UTC for increased gateway TLS errors in eu-west1.

alex_eng: Two-pronged repro plan: (1) ask customer to run `dig +trace api.eu-west1.redwoodapi.com` and `curl --resolve api.eu-west1.redwoodapi.com:443:52.35.12.7 -v /v1/generate` to isolate client resolver vs path; (2) we rotate the resolver binding on a canary edge and monitor.

jen_support: Customer ran `dig` and saw occasional ";; connection timed out; no servers could be reached" toward their ISP resolver, and when they switched to 1.1.1.1 the curl completed successfully. They've attached pcap showing repeated DNS retries before the TLS attempt.

maria_runtime: That points to intermittent DNS failures causing the client to retry and hit backend timeouts. We should: update the support doc to recommend fallback resolvers and reduce our upstream resolver TTL for the CNAMEs during rotations. Also add a short-term mitigation: enable fallback to the regional replica for this customer.

tom_sre: I've already put a temp routing policy to prefer eu-west1-repl while we validate. Also kicked off a probe to the resolver that returned SERVFAIL to see if it's misbehaving.

jen_support: Customer confirmed reduced errors after switching to 1.1.1.1 and after we flipped routing. They're still collecting traces; want a postmortem once probe finishes.

maria_runtime: Action items: 1) run a 24h query-latency report for eu-west1 resolvers, 2) add guidance for customers about resolver fallback and DNS cache TTLs during cert rotations/rollouts, 3) investigate if our cert rotation coordination changed DNS TTLs unintentionally.

alex_eng: I'll draft the KB entry and include recommended client-side checks (dig, curl resolve, pcap).

jen_support: Thanks team. I'll update ticket C-1829 and keep customer notified. :thumbsup:
